regime_context: The detector shows Memory, HBM & Storage as the dominant thematic leader with a wide margin, strong durability (0.77), and no crowding. AI-related themes cluster near the top, but there is no 'one-narrative' structure. The absolute-trend gate has historically helped reduce drawdowns in this market; cross-sectional momentum ranks carry no return-forecast edge. Rotation margin is wide with no confirmed handoff.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: The theme holds the #1 rank with high durability and is eligible under the absolute-trend gate. It is not crowded, so a trend-following allocation would lean long. This is a directional lean, not a prediction of return – the trend gate helps control downside, while the rank merely focuses attention.
theses.dissent: Cross-sectional momentum rank has no forward return-forecast edge; an extended leader can mean-revert sharply. The theme's high durability may already be priced in.

falsifier.text: Theme durability drops below 0.6 and rank falls to 3 or lower, OR ETF proxy SMH closes below its 50-day moving average for 3 consecutive trading days.

theses.subject: Semiconductor Equipment (WFE)
theses.thesis: While still eligible (trend gate passed) and with a positive rank (0.907), the theme is crowded (z=1.24) and carries a mean-revert Hurst tag, suggesting trend fatigue. Crowding alone is not a fade trigger, but combined with the mean-revert signal it warrants a sizing caution expressed as avoidance.
theses.dissent: The positive score and eligibility show the trend is still technically intact. Crowding has no basket-level forward drawdown edge and mean-revert tags can reverse; avoiding it could mean missing further upside.

falsifier.text: Crowding z drops below 0.5 and Hurst tag shifts to 'trend' OR the theme's rank moves into the top 3 for 5 consecutive days.

theses.subject: Managed Care & Insurers
theses.thesis: The theme has high durability (0.79) and a positive rank (0.458, eligible), but it is the most crowded theme in the universe (z=1.83). While crowding is a size-down caution, not a fade, the extreme reading makes it unattractive to add exposure here. The trend-gate protects, but does not justify overweight.
theses.dissent: Managed care is a defensive sector with a durable trend; extreme crowding can persist and even intensify in a risk-off environment. Avoiding it could be a missed opportunity if the theme continues to lead.

falsifier.text: Crowding z falls below 0.5 and the theme's rank improves to top 5, OR XLV closes at a new 3-month high on above-average volume.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
